mission: Legitimate cryptocurrency actually received in owner-approved addresses; no claims of money without independent payment evidence.
owner_order_source: Current user-authorized conversation context; future ChatGPT messages are not automatically visible to GitHub. Additional instructions can be synced into this file through an authorized session.
command_chain: 2 independent assistants per director, separate review line

audit_policy.source_of_truth: Do not treat GitHub code presence as active AI operation or verified receipt.
audit_policy.execution_actions: Only read-only validation, source research within configured limits, vetted evidence summarization and clearly authorized posts on the owner's repository. Arbitrary owner-comment text is never executed as shell code.
audit_policy.hard_limits: No private keys, credentials, wallet signing, money transfers, spam or invented earnings.

orders.title: Coin-only mission
orders.standing_requirement: The team must seek legitimate transferable cryptocurrency received at owner-approved correct-network addresses, and not count fiat-only work, points, empty balances, offers or claims as earnings.
orders.verification_condition: Validate correct receiving chain/token and independently confirmed credit; nothing is yet proven received.

orders.title: Ten accountable directors
orders.standing_requirement: Ten directors independently set strategies but are ultimately accountable to owner and communicate verifiable work evidence.
orders.verification_condition: Validate hierarchy, director reporting and source-backed performance updates.

orders.title: Two independent assistants per director
orders.standing_requirement: Twenty independent assistants research and challenge, each reporting directly to one director.
orders.verification_condition: Check unique names, parents and actual separate model outputs.

orders.title: Fifteen managers per company
orders.standing_requirement: Ten companies with exactly fifteen managers each.
orders.verification_condition: Check 150 manager IDs and exact one reporting director.

orders.title: Fifty workers per manager
orders.standing_requirement: Each of 150 managers owns fifty distinct research workers, 7500 total.
orders.verification_condition: Check 7500 distinct worker IDs, 50 per manager and executed report counts separately.

orders.title: 150 subagents per worker
orders.standing_requirement: Each of 7500 worker roles defines 150 unique specialized children with exactly one parent, total 1125000 defined.
orders.verification_condition: Check uniqueness formula, valid parent chains, child inference success counts.

orders.title: Independence and reporting
orders.standing_requirement: Every role can choose and challenge research independently while following a single manager chain, with verifiable execution.
orders.verification_condition: Separate configured role, model call actually completed, and externally authenticated identity.

orders.title: Worldwide deep research
orders.standing_requirement: Search genuine paying work worldwide, consider nontraditional sectors, investigate original sources and challenge scam signals.
orders.verification_condition: Check working research results, freshness, actual payer, scope and payout evidence.

orders.title: Cross-team communication
orders.standing_requirement: Directors share source-linked leads, avoid duplicates, assign one accountable owner per opportunity and compare assistants' findings.
orders.verification_condition: Check real generated handoffs and communication results, not just scheduled code.

orders.title: Warm relevant replies
orders.standing_requirement: Provide kind, factual, non-spammy response drafts to genuine clients with a real agreed paid scope; post only via authorized connected accounts.
orders.verification_condition: Separate draft from actually sent messages and prevent unsupported mass posting.

orders.title: Team general conference
orders.standing_requirement: Make the 10 companies' individually identified roles available to review and permit informative public meeting participation supported by actual reports.
orders.verification_condition: Introductions are scripted; do not call all roles live public participants.

orders.title: Anonymous identity and safe wallet routes
orders.standing_requirement: Only anonymous mission and approved receiving routes may be distributed; no personal biography, login, credentials, full address map or custodial memo in public code.
orders.verification_condition: Complete private directory currently requires an owner-configured encrypted setting. Never falsely claim deployed.

orders.title: Payment authenticity and no fees
orders.standing_requirement: Reject pay-first schemes; verify BTC mainnet or genuine USDC chain/token and, for custodial receiving routes, memo and account credit.
orders.verification_condition: Do not verify money without independent receipt evidence.

orders.title: Independent AI model operation
orders.standing_requirement: Active roles should perform real separate AI inference when a model is available, rather than being names on a spreadsheet.
orders.verification_condition: Report successful model calls and worker/source failures; unknown until current workflow completes.

orders.title: Conference invites to collaborators
orders.standing_requirement: Invite genuine outside collaborators to bring real source-linked paid work through the owner's existing public meeting, not unsolicited mass DM campaigns.
orders.verification_condition: Only confirmed genuine external engagement counts as outreach.

orders.title: Owner orders audited and executed
orders.standing_requirement: Every owner instruction needs a scoped action, accountable director, audit evidence and truthful state, with no unsupported promises.
orders.verification_condition: Only whitelisted and permitted actions are executable; new chat messages require explicit synchronization to the GitHub registry.
